negative_reviews.author: Karthik Sunil
negative_reviews.text:
Got food poisoning from chicken ramen.
Other reviewers have had this issue from the Aberdeen branch too. 🙃

It arrived very quickly after ordering. Typically takes longer. Chicken tasted off, undercooked, soft and mushy. I very rarely get this feeling, normally fine after having chicken.

Large portions for the noodles in the ramen, but the broth tastes bland. I had same experience before.

Staff service is great. But overpriced. 😔

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo Weekly Dash PDF overview (Sales Overview) — gap-site weekly sales; ops metrics not in this source. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers fell by 244 week on week while spend per head rose by £1.78.
Sales were £43,575.47 on the BOH meeting sheet, beating the £38,500 target by £5,075.47 (13.18%).
Operational labour was 20.51% (£8,934.42) against a 22% target, with total labour at £10,541.32 (24%) and 608.41 hours used.
Sides have been at 15.62% for the last three weeks.
Food cost was 24.26%, better than 26.24% the week before but not yet back down for the month, and the site expects to be around 23% for the month within two weeks.
The delivery promotion and student app discounts are still costing money, and Penny said app voucher changes should go live within the month.
Food variance was -4.6% and drinks variance -1.2%.
The site received six 5 star and one 1 star Google reviews.
Bidfood starts as a new supplier at this site first, and Penny advised keeping a reserve of key items rather than expecting full reliability from the start.
High priority maintenance jobs are wobbly tables, an emergency light out on the ramen line, the Maki Biru beer line not working at all and the bar fridge handle coming off.

Medium priority jobs are the heat lamps, the Kobas printer, an overheating stock room and waiter stations 1 and 2 coming away from the wall, and the bar fridge is still intermittently leaking (low priority).
A FOH trial shift took place and the outcome is still to be caught up on.
The site needs to hire another supervisor and another part time FOH team member, but Talent Funnel is auto rejecting people once they complete onboarding.
Review volume, Mapal, the Asana lists and the Slerp workflow are the stated areas for improvement, and sanding the walls is an open question.
The GM has returned to many memos and changes and needs to watch the roundtable meeting and sweep weekly tasks, Deliveroo and the rota.
The Deliveroo promotion memo needs to be found beyond a screenshot.
XOXO, lunch, the apps and Deliveroo are the upcoming promotions.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): last week's chicken broth usage discrepancy was traced to a takeaway recipe still linked to the old tonkotsu broth in stock counts, which has been corrected, so usage should return to normal next week.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): frozen ramen promotion stock is delivered from the factory on 07/10, but storage space at the smaller sites is unconfirmed and the memo does not specify quantities per flavour.
